resources.string: Tailscale
Enable Tailscale

Connect to your Tailnet devices while keeping TrackerControl blocking. Normal internet traffic uses your current connection. Tailscale contacts its coordination and relay services. Starting protection replaces another active VPN. While enabled, 100.64.0.0/10 is reserved for Tailscale; carrier services using that range may be unavailable. Short device names use MagicDNS instead of local network DNS. Apps excluded from TrackerControl cannot use this connection.
